title: Who buys Maui County homes: non-homeowner share of sales by price tier (FY2016-FY2026) and owner/acquirer origin by district, type and value tier

sales_by_conveyance_schedule.producer: scripts/conveyance/maui_sales_extract.py (copy at dl/appl2/maui_sales_extract.py.txt) from County of Maui RPT Sales Data File (DocumentCenter View/8070, file dated 2026-09-22, 520,135 rows) and RPT Full Assessment Listing as of 2026-04-06 (View/8079); see dl/appl2/maui_sources.json
sales_by_conveyance_schedule.identical_copies: dl/appl2 and dl/appleseed/repo copies of maui_sales_history and maui_sales_totals have identical SHA-256

owners.parcel_fabric_mailing: Maui County GIS Parcel_Fabric_Layers/FeatureServer/1 (data last edit 2026-10-04): one tax-bill mailing address per parcel/CPR unit
owners.situs_class: PARCELINFO/FeatureServer/0 (CAMA join, weekly; situs city, tax class, CPR)
owners.certified_roll: Maui_County_Certified_Parcels_2026 tables RPFOWNER, RPFMAIL, RPFVALUE, RPFLEASE, RPFADDR (data edited 2026-04-10, TAXYR 2026)

benchmarks.title_guaranty: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-moku/72fb7234-fad9-5bdc-aaaa-c922016ddc21/scratchpad/an/new/tg.json (Title Guaranty Buyer Statistics, Maui County panels)

method: (a) maui_sales_history_fy2016_2026.csv rows are recorded documents (multi-parcel deeds counted once by instrument / Land Court number) with a price and conveyance tax. The extract assigns each to the HRS 247-2 schedule its recorded tax fits within 2%: schedule (2) = 'nonowner' (condo or single-family sale to a buyer not eligible for the county homeowner exemption); schedule (1) on improved residential parcels = 'owner'; schedule (1) elsewhere (vacant land, commercial, ag) and unmatched taxes = 'nonres'. Non-homeowner share = nonowner / (owner + nonowner), by count and by summed price, per fiscal year (July-June; FY2026 = Jul 2025-Jun 2026).

(a) Tiers: price bins (edges 0, 600K, 800K, 1M, then 250K steps to 6M, 500K steps to 10M; $10M+ listed singly as kind 'top') summed into entry <$800K (proxy for <$750K: the $750K cut falls inside the $600-800K bin; <$600K and $600-800K are shown separately under entry_detail), mid $800K-1.5M, upper $1.5-3M, luxury $3-10M, ultra $10M+. Sales of whole 5+ unit buildings (kind 'mf') are excluded from tiers and listed per FY.

(a) House vs condo: maui_sales_value_price_fy2023_2026.csv, the extract's arm's-length subset (FY2023-26 owner/nonowner documents whose parcels are all in the 2026 listing, none left out, price 0.5-2.5x combined assessed value, improved). condo = every parcel a CPR unit (suffix != 0000), which also includes CPR'd house lots. The same file's owner_occupied_now flag (homeowner exemption in the 2026 listing) is cross-tabulated against the schedule at purchase.

(b) No last-sale date or price exists in the Maui parcel fabric, PARCELINFO or certified-roll tables (fabric LGLSTARTDT is a parcel legal start date: ~200-400 per year, not sales), and the county's parcel-level sales file is not on disk (only its aggregated outputs). So (b) reports the CURRENT owner-origin mix of all residential parcels (a STOCK measure of ownership, not of buying), plus an inferred flow proxy.

(b) Stock: every 13-digit TMK (CPR units count individually; 'CONDO MASTER' records excluded) in residential tax classes 1, 2, 9, 10, 11, 12 (labels inferred, see owners_neighbor notes). Origin = live fabric tax-bill mailing address (certified-roll first addressed owner when the fabric address is blank), classified with the owners_neighbor build's parser: Hawaii (split Maui County vs other islands by USPS ZIP), US mainland + DC, foreign country, territories/APO. Type: condo_cpr_unit (CPR suffix != 0000), house_non_cpr (building value > 0), lot_no_building. Value tier: certified 2026 land + building value at the task's cut points ($750K/1.5M/3M/10M). District: PARCELINFO situs city plus TMK zone/section: West Maui split at TMK section 4-4/4-5 (north: Kaanapali-Kahana-Napili-Kapalua; south: Lahaina town incl. the 2023 burn area, Launiupoko, Olowalu), Lanai = TMK 4-9, Kihei = situs Kihei in TMK zone 3, Wailea-Makena = situs Kihei/Makena in TMK zone 2, Upcountry = Kula/Makawao/Pukalani, Haiku-Paia, Central = Kahului/Wailuku/Puunene, Hana = TMK zone 1, Molokai = zones 5-6.

(b) Concentration: parcels whose identical normalized mailing address is shared by 10+ parcels are treated as institutional/managed (funds, developers, landholders, rental managers); top origins are reported for all residential parcels, for parcels at addresses with <10 parcels (individual-scale owners) and for the 10+ group.

(b) Flow proxy ('inferred recent acquirers'): a residential parcel counts as recently acquired when its live-fabric owner (2026-10-04) shares no identifying name token (surname for 'LAST,FIRST' names; non-generic words for entities) with ANY owner or mailing name on the certified 2026 roll (published 2026-04-10). Leasehold/executive-order parcels, government owners and parcels absent from the roll are skipped; acquisitions whose fabric mailing address is identical to the roll's and is not the property's own address are dropped as likely renamings or un-updated records. Origin uses the live fabric address only (the roll fallback would be the prior owner). Tier uses certified assessed value, not price.
Small cells: every result with fewer than 20 classified records carries small_cell_flag 'n<20'.
notes: SCHEDULE (2) IS NOT 'OUT-OF-STATE': it marks buyers who are not eligible for a Maui homeowner exemption on the purchased condo/house, as declared for the conveyance tax. It includes mainland and foreign second-home buyers, investors and vacation-rental buyers, entity buyers, and Hawaii residents who already hold a home exemption elsewhere (local landlords, move-up buyers who have not yet sold). It can miss owner-occupants who pay schedule (2) and later claim the exemption: 7.8% of FY2023-25 arm's-length schedule-(2) purchases now carry a homeowner exemption (18.7% of houses, 3.8% of condo units), while 69.7% of schedule-(1) purchases do.

Mailing-address origin is where the tax bill goes, not residence: off-island owners using a Maui property manager or attorney count as Maui, and local owners with mainland trustees count as mainland. Treat non-Hawaii shares as a floor on non-resident ownership.

Owner-origin results are a STOCK of current owners, not buyers. The only buyer-flow measures here are (a) the conveyance schedule and (b) the inferred-acquirer proxy. Title Guaranty's Maui County buyer statistics (benchmark below) are the published flow measure of buyer origin.

Inferred-acquirer window: the roll's owner-of-record date is not documented. 1,365 private residential parcels changed to an unrelated owner name (1,028 kept after the address filter), roughly 5-8 months of FY2026's residential sales pace (2,068 owner+nonowner documents in 12 months), so treat it as recorded transfers from about early 2026 to early October 2026. It includes some non-sale transfers (estate distributions, renamings to differently named trusts or LLCs, foreclosures) and developer sales of new units, and misses sales between parties sharing a surname token. Its foreign share (5.8%, almost all Canada) is well above Title Guaranty's ~1% for Maui County in 2025 and Jan-Jun 2026; treat the foreign share as an upper bound. The mainland share (29.4%) is close to TG's 28% (Jan-Jun 2026).

Price tiers in (a) are price-based; in (b) they are assessed-value based. Arm's-length improved sales sold at 0.97-1.10x their assessed value (sum price / sum assessed, FY2023-26 by house/condo), so the two tier systems line up roughly, but individual parcels can cross tiers.
(a) Entry tier is <$800K (bin edge), not <$750K. Ultra ($10M+) cells are small in most years (n<20 flagged); pooled FY2024-26 ultra has 44 sales.

(a) The extract applies the current HRS 247-2 schedule pair to every year; unmatched documents stay at 33-78 per year (counted with nonres and excluded). Developer sales (county validity code 8) are 8-13% of FY2023-26 home sales above $1M (maui_developer_share_fy2023_2026.csv); new-project condo sales land mostly on schedule (2).

(a) FY2024 begins one month before the 8 Aug 2023 Lahaina wildfire; burned-lot sales on schedule (1) are 'nonres' (vacant land) and drop out of the share. The 'West Maui S' district in (b) contains the burn area, where many parcels now have no building ('lot_no_building').

Tax-class labels for Maui codes are inferred (owners_neighbor notes): 9 owner-occupied, 1 non-owner-occupied residential, 11 short-term rental, 12 long-term rental, 2 apartment, 10 commercialized residential.

HMDA covers only financed purchases (no cash buyers). Its 2025 second-home/investment share (18.9%) is much lower than the conveyance non-homeowner share (~57%), consistent with non-homeowner buyers paying cash far more often, and with local landlords and move-up buyers financing as investment or not appearing in HMDA at all. HMDA property_value is reported in $10K bands.

Privacy: aggregates only. No owner names, street addresses or parcel ids are written; ZIP-level counts are given only for the top 15 mainland ZIPs of each group (smallest listed: 14 parcels); in the 10+ group each listed ZIP is one shared mailing address (an institutional or managed owner), identified by ZIP only.
Hawaii County and Kauai County owner mailing data were not obtainable (owners_neighbor); this file covers Maui County (Maui, Molokai, Lanai) only.
